startup_broadcasts.body: Do not pursue a minimum-counterexample analysis unless prior development has already forced any minimum counterexample to have bounded order: there must be an explicit finite upper bound on the number of vertices. Until such a bounded-order reduction exists, use structural, topological, algebraic, constructive, or other non-minimum-counterexample approaches instead.
